results.condition:
Build a polished, browser-playable first-person shooter vertical slice in Three.js.

Requirements:
- Create the game under project/ with a responsive Vite-style browser app.
- Deliver a visually cohesive AAA-inspired tactical environment, weapon, HUD, lighting, materials, collision, aiming, shooting, reload, enemy targets, damage, and win/lose/restart states.
- Use the load-sketchfab-threejs skill to find and integrate a suitable downloadable GLB asset; preserve attribution and verify geometry, materials, and animations in the browser.
- Use the gauntlet-loop workflow: fan out independent builder and harsh visual-critic subagents, iterate on concrete findings, and rerun verification after fixes.
- Verify the playable result in a real browser, including controls and responsive layout.
- Run relevant tests/build checks, capture final playable screenshots under screenshots/ with final-* filenames, commit and push the finished work, and report the public verification URL.

Acceptance requires a working browser game and direct visual/runtime evidence, not only source or build output.

Mandatory workflow skills: gauntlet-loop, load-sketchfab-threejs. Before implementing, read every listed skill's `SKILL.md` and follow its instructions for this request. If a listed skill applies to the requested feature or assets, you must use it; do not substitute a generic or procedural workaround when the skill provides the required workflow. For example, when `load-sketchfab-threejs` is listed, use it to obtain and integrate at least one suitable Sketchfab/GLB asset, preserve attribution, and verify that asset renders in the browser. If a listed skill genuinely does not apply, state why in the completion report.

Mandatory orchestration: before declaring the game complete, use OpenCode's `task` tool to launch separate child sessions for:

- builder: implement or improve the game feature;
- critic: independently inspect the current browser result against a concrete named reference and report the single biggest remaining gap;
- verifier: run browser checks and verify the gameplay loop.

Launch independent builder/critic work as parallel background subagents when supported. Wait for all child sessions, apply the critic's concrete finding through an implementation or remediation step, and run verification again afterward. Do not claim a critique loop ran unless the task tool returns distinct child session IDs and the critic produces a concrete finding. If the task tool is unavailable, stop and report the blocker instead of silently doing the work in one agent.
results.evidence: Game: Vite + Three.js FPS vertical slice at project/ — commit [5ccfd40](https://github.com/agents-dev/aiplay/commit/5ccfd4015a035e312c294ea4fff456d8753208ce) (6h ago). Playable: `npm run dev` → http://127.0.0.1:5173 (PointerLock FPS, WASD/mouse, RMB ADS FOV 74→52, R reload, Shift sprint, collision, 8 targets raycast 50/100 headshot, enemy return fire, win/lose/restart). Sketchfab GLB: Remington 700 Police Tactical `d14f459bf31f47df887e107f86645318` by calico16 (CC Attribution) — `public/models/rifle.glb` 254588 bytes, 14 meshes, 7 mats, 0 tex, loaded via GLTFLoader `src/main.js:210` with attribution JSON + HUD footer, A/B verified `document.body.dataset.compareState=ready` (Three.js rendered, 7 mat, non-zero tris). Gauntlet loop: builder `ses_fbf2d5d1` (recoil spring, ADS, shell bounce), critic `ses_fbf2bca8` (vs COD MWII Killhouse — harsh verdict B wins, gap=flat primitive/cyan; remediated: removed cyan strips, desaturated concrete PBR, spots 120→16, exposure 0.96, dust volumes, warm 3200K), verifier `ses_fbf2b21` (build PASS, all gameplay sub-checks PASS). Browser verified via Playwright (canvas 1280x720, `window.__game.getState()=playing`, ammo `30 / 90`). Screenshots: [final-desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agents-dev/aiplay/5ccfd4015a035e312c294ea4fff456d8753208ce/project/screenshots/final-desktop.png), [final-mobile](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agents-dev/aiplay/5ccfd4015a035e312c294ea4fff456d8753208ce/project/screenshots/final-mobile.png), [final-gameplay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agents-dev/aiplay/5ccfd4015a035e312c294ea4fff456d8753208ce/project/screenshots/final-gameplay.png), [final-rifle-ab](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/agents-dev/aiplay/5ccfd4015a035e312c294ea4fff456d8753208ce/project/screenshots/final-rifle-ab.png). Tests: `node --test` 4/4 pass. Build: `vite build` 594kB (gzip 154kB) success.
